items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: I knew a few people that played with him, like Joe Bentley that's always played.

ctx.x: Oh, he was a, he could play bass, real good bass player. But he had a heart as big as, big as a house. Had a good band, tremendous band.
But I've heard so much about it, I know. I knew a few people that played with him, like Joe Bentley that's always played. He played the trumpet player.
